caption: Do racing wheels come with pedals? The Logitech G923 ($230), the Thrustmaster T248R ($300) and the Moza R3 for Xbox ($329) all have them in the box. On day one the wheel clamps to a desk and the pedals go on the floor. Prices are our estimates. We earn from qualifying purchases. #simracing #ps5
title: Do racing wheels come with pedals? Open one starter box
